anomalies.observed: The STM32H753 VCAP pins on FCC1 are connected to UART3_TX_FCC and UART3_RX_FCC. The STM32F405 VCAP_1 and VCAP_2 pins on NAVC1 are connected to I2C3_SDA_NAVC and UART3_TX_NAVC. No VCAP capacitors are shown.
anomalies.expected: The MCUs' VCAP pins should be connected to the external capacitors required by their datasheets, not used as signal or interface pins.

evidence.quote: FCC1: pin 48 VCAP — UART3_TX_FCC; pin 73 VCAP — UART3_RX_FCC. No VCAP capacitors shown. (Flight Control Computer, page 2/6)
NAVC1: VCAP_1 — I2C3_SDA_NAVC; VCAP_2 — UART3_TX_NAVC. No VCAP capacitors shown. (Navigation Computer, page 3/6)
Flight Control Computer MCU: STM32H753VITx; Navigation Computer MCU: STM32F405RGTx. (Component Table, Hades)

anomalies.impact: The MCU internal core regulators may not operate correctly without their required VCAP capacitors. The signal connections also misuse pins that are not general-purpose UART or I2C pins, so the associated interfaces will not function as intended.

parsed.summary: Both MCUs have their VCAP regulator pins assigned to signal nets, with no required VCAP capacitors shown. This is a serious power-design fault that can prevent reliable MCU operation and disables the affected interfaces.
